references.text: Introduces him as one of Noah's sons and establishes the background for his descendants mentioned in Genesis 10:6
A parallel genealogy that repeats Ham's sons: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan, and their descendants
Details the descendants of Canaan, one of Ham's sons mentioned in Genesis 10:6
Mentions Israel's stay in Ham's land (Egypt), linking to Mizraim, one of Ham's sons
Refers to the destruction of Egypt's firstborn in Ham's tents, linking to Mizraim, Ham's son
Prophecies against Egypt and Cush, who are direct descendants of Ham mentioned in Genesis 10:6
Prophecies against Egypt, Cush, and Put, who are descendants of Ham mentioned in Genesis 10:6
Mentions Cush and Put as Egypt's strength, linking together three of Ham's sons
A direct parallel confirming Ham's lineage in two different Bible books.
Expands the list by showing Cush's (Ham's son) own sons.
Summarizes and provides theological context for the dispersion of Ham's four sons.
